sources.title: Claude Squad README
sources.locator: Overview, setup, features and component boundaries
sources.finding: cs launches configurable Claude/Codex/Gemini/Aider commands in tmux sessions and Git worktrees. Keyboard actions create, attach, review diff, commit/push, check out/pause and resume; experimental auto-accept is opt-in.

sources.title: Claude Squad license
sources.finding: The cited root license governs this repository distribution, subject to component notices.

sources.title: Claude Squad build manifest
sources.finding: Pinned build metadata identifies the implementation used by the documented application.

sources.title: Claude Squad v1.0.20
sources.finding: v1.0.20 records base-commit tracking and recovery for instances whose tmux server/session died.

sources.title: Claude Squad session/storage.go
sources.finding: Source inspection links the session UI to JSON persistence of title, path, branch, status, program, worktree identity and diff stats via SaveInstances/LoadInstances. This is session persistence, not a separate issue tracker.

sources.title: Claude Squad session/instance.go
sources.locator: FromInstanceData; Start; Pause; Resume; SendPrompt; PreviewFullHistory
sources.finding: Source inspection of the documented pause/resume flow shows restoration of stored instances and tmux connections. Missing tmux sessions become Paused; Resume rebuilds missing worktrees and starts or restores tmux. SendPrompt sends terminal keys; PreviewFullHistory captures tmux scrollback. No recovery fixture was run.

sources.title: Claude Squad official repository description
sources.finding: Official repository describes managing multiple AI terminal agents like Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Amp. README separately documents configurable -p commands and named program profiles.

sources.title: claude-squad README
sources.locator: Prerequisites (Codex API key line); License section
sources.finding: For Codex the user sets their own OpenAI API key; the README states no price.

sources.title: Claude Squad LICENSE.md
sources.finding: The repository is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License version 3.

sources.title: Claude Squad README
sources.locator: Installation (Homebrew and Manual) sections, commit ce1ffb4
sources.finding: Claude Squad installs as the cs binary through Homebrew or a public install script; the README names no price, account or paid plan.

sources.title: Claude Squad homepage
sources.finding: The homepage gives Homebrew and shell-script installation and states the software is licensed under GNU AGPL v3.0. It shows no pricing or paid plan.

sources.title: Claude Squad tmux session start
sources.finding: Each session runs the configured program command (default claude) unmodified inside a new tmux session in the task worktree, so the installed agent CLI uses its own stored sign-in.
